title: Vite dev server proxies /api to the Go backend
summary: Dev requests to /api reach the backend instead of returning index.html
description: Context: client.ts calls relative paths like /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current, and vite.config.ts only sets publicDir, alias and server.fs. Desired: server.proxy forwards '/api' to http://localhost:8080. Expected: the round JSON loads in dev. Why: removes the root cause of the error.
acceptance_criteria: Given vite.config.ts, When the config is loaded, Then server.proxy['/api'].target equals 'http://localhost:8080'
Given the proxy is added, When the config is loaded, Then publicDir, the @game alias and server.fs.allow are unchanged
